_description: Request body for POST /social-posts/bulk-delete: removes up to 100 posts from PostFast in one call (any status). Published posts stay live on the platform. Confirm with the user before sending.
_notes: ids: 1-100 post UUIDs; [] returns 400, more than 100 returns 400, a non-UUID returns 400
notFoundIds = ids that don't exist or belong to another workspace; repeating a call is harmless
Response status is 200, not 201; one call counts as one request (200/hour)
To delete everything matching a filter, re-read GET /social-posts?page=0 with the filter and bulk-delete until data is empty
